purpose: Consolidation of already executed research; no new experiments in this archive build
independence_warning: Experimental runs reuse common input/underlying hardware and should not be summed as statistically independent; old delivery ZIPs duplicate included files.
scientific_conclusion: Make-before-break generally reduced observed application-response gaps, while locked P1/P1-v1.1 has not established robust superiority over B4 in measured endpoint tests.
